name: Chervon Holdings Limited
summary: Chervon Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, testing, sale, and after-sale servicing of power tools, outdoor power equipment, and related products in North America, Europe, China, and internationally. It operates through Power Tools, Outdoor Power Equipment, and Others segments. The company offers power tools and accessories for consumer, professionals, and industrial users, as well as original design manufacturer (ODM) customers; and outdoor tools and its accessories for professional and mass-market users.
